# Xinrui Zu

> Xinrui Zu (祖新瑞, "zuxinrui") is a PhD student at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
> (VU Amsterdam), in the Computational Intelligence Group and the Quantitative
> Data Analytics Group, advised by Kevin Sebastian Luck and Shujian Yu. His
> research uses optimal transport to align the geometric structure of learned
> representations across sensory modalities and domains: robot learning,
> multimodal representation alignment, Gromov-Wasserstein methods for robot
> perception, generative models for medical imaging, and dimensionality reduction.
> He is based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, and also designs and builds robots.

## Selected publications
- UniOMA — Gromov-Wasserstein structural alignment for multimodal robot perception (vision, force, tactile, IMU, proprioception); improves robustness to sensor dropout. IEEE ICRA 2026 (Late-Breaking Results) and the "From Data to Decisions" workshop. https://openreview.net/forum?id=rcc5qZ6CtV
- SpaceMAP — dimensionality reduction / high-dimensional data visualization by space expansion. ICML 2022. https://proceedings.mlr.press/v162/zu22a.html
- Deep Recursive Embedding — high-dimensional data embedding for visualization. IEEE TVCG 2022. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/9585419
- cHeartFlow — contrastive generative model that synthesizes cardiac MR images from sketches. MIDL 2024. https://openreview.net/forum?id=orIWvvBK2v
